notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Improvements:

An error display has been added. Now you know where you went wrong

The home interface has been improved. It's now clearer and more user-friendly

The map of the district has been improved. Districts beyond the Great Wall have been added

Bugs fixed



Thank you all for your ideas and suggestions that make the game better.



Please report bugs, suggestions, etc. on my Discord.
